# Getting help and supporting Lanternfall

## Get help

- **Read the guide first.** The [game guide](../docs/GAME_GUIDE.md) has a walkthrough, every monster, boss, item, quest, fish and recipe.
- **Found a bug?** [Open a bug report](https://github.com/CptNope/Laternfall/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Say which browser and device you use and what you were doing when it went wrong.
- **Have an idea?** [Suggest it](https://github.com/CptNope/Laternfall/issues/new?template=idea.yml). The [roadmap](../ROADMAP.md#how-to-propose-something) explains what helps.
- **Rather email?** Write to [info@jeremyanderson.tech](mailto:info@jeremyanderson.tech).

## Support the game

Lanternfall is free, with no ads and no purchases, and it will stay that way. If you enjoy it:

- 💛 **[Donate on itch.io](https://cptnope.itch.io/lanternfall/donate)**. Any amount helps more games get made.
- ⭐ Star this repository, and rate or comment on the [itch.io page](https://cptnope.itch.io/lanternfall).
- 📣 Share the game, or the [write-up on jeremyanderson.tech](https://jeremyanderson.tech/project/lanternfall-browser-jrpg/), with someone who misses 16-bit RPGs.
